mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 47 degrees at Badger Ridge Middle School under the glow of a full moon, with an air quality index of 53.
The city has announced that Highway M will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for final asphalt and marking work, and please be aware of email scams impersonating city employees for zoning fees.

We have a busy schedule with the Dane County Farmers Market today, yoga at Insight Wellness on September 28, and plenty of trivia and music nights coming up at local spots like Hop Haus and Paddy Macs.
A noteworthy call from September 5 involved an officer finding vehicles with cheese on their windshields as part of a social media prank called the Dairy Dare, thankfully causing no damage.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious OREO REESE'S Cheesecake and Culver's will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
